prompt: A modern kitchen island with a white quartz countertop, navy-blue cabinet base with drawers and brass pulls, an overhang with three wooden bar stools, a small sink with a faucet, and a fruit bowl and cutting board on top.

A generic round robot vacuum cleaner: dark grey top with a raised lidar turret, a front bumper, side brushes that spin, and small wheels underneath. It drives an animated path around a simple room floor with a sofa and a rug, turning when it bumps obstacles.

A generic acoustic guitar: spruce-colored top with a round sound hole and rosette, dark rosewood back and sides, a long neck with frets and fret markers, a headstock with six tuning pegs, a bridge, and six strings. It stands on a simple guitar stand.

A vintage biplane in cream and red: two stacked wings connected by struts and bracing wires, an open cockpit with a windscreen, a radial engine with a spinning propeller, fixed landing gear, and a tail with rudder. It flies in a slow circle over a grass field.

A suspension bridge spanning a river gorge: two tall towers, main cables forming catenary curves, many vertical hanger cables, a road deck with lane markings, and a few small cars moving across. Water flows below.

A mossy fallen log on a forest floor with a cluster of mushrooms of different sizes (red caps with white spots and brown caps), ferns, a few pebbles, and scattered leaves. Soft dappled light filtering through.

A brass orrery (mechanical solar system model): a glowing sun at the center, planets on arms at different radii orbiting at speeds proportional to real orbital periods, a moon orbiting the earth, and a gear base with visible gears turning. A slider controls simulation speed.

A gourmet burger on a wooden board: sesame-seed brioche bun, beef patty with grill marks, melting cheddar, lettuce, tomato slices, red onion rings, pickles, held together with a small skewer, plus a side of fries in a paper cone and a ramekin of ketchup.

An airport departure gate area about 20 m x 12 m: rows of connected seating, a gate desk with a screen showing a generic flight number, large floor-to-ceiling windows with a parked airplane visible outside, overhead signage with gate letters and arrows, and a trash bin. Camera at 1.6 m eye height.

An original penguin chef character (not based on any existing IP): round black-and-white penguin wearing a tall white chef's hat and a small apron, holding a wooden spoon, standing next to a tiny stove with a pot. It stirs the pot in a looping animation.
